which_endpoint: PFS (nivolumab+ipilimumab vs chemo, TMB >=10 mut/Mb; Part 1 co-primary)
search_notes: BMS release of 5 Feb 2018 (opened via Ono mirror dated 6 Feb) said the PFS co-primary in TMB-high was met; HR came at AACR/NEJM 16 Apr 2018 (97.5% CI). Multi-part trial with several primaries: later OS readouts (2019) were not traced here, and the registry PCD (2024) reflects final follow-up, hence a lag of about -6.7 years.

No Roche topline release found; Roche Q1 2025 slides (24 Apr 2025) only said "data update at upcoming congress". Earliest dated source opened is EHA 2025 coverage of 14 Jun 2025 (abstract S101); the talk may have been 13 Jun and the abstract text may have been online from mid-May 2025, which I could not verify.

BMS release of 13 Feb 2025 gave no numbers; HR first shown at ASCO 2025 (LBA9500, coverage dated 3 Jun 2025, exact talk day +/-1) and later in Nat Med (epub 18 Oct 2025). Registry status TERMINATED although the primary analysis was completed.

RATIONALE-311 (BeiGene, now BeOne): no press release, congress abstract or paper found in English searches; the only result is the ClinicalTrials.gov posting of 13 Apr 2026 (HR 0.92, p=0.30) and a sponsor plain-language summary dated March 2026. An earlier line in an SEC filing or a Chinese-language notice is possible but was not found.
Amgen topline of 11 Apr 2025: OS met at the planned interim analysis (data cut-off 29 Jan 2025 = registry PCD), no numbers. HR first public at ASCO 2025 with simultaneous NEJM (epub 2 Jun 2025).

which_endpoint: PFS (PD-L1 CPS>=1 and all participants; both primaries met)
search_notes: Merck topline of 15 May 2025 (KEYNOTE-B96/ENGOT-ov65, no acronym in registry) gave no numbers; HRs first at ESMO 2025 LBA3 on 18 Oct 2025. HR shown is for CPS>=1; all-comers HR 0.70 (0.58-0.84) per the Lancet paper.

Johnpro Biotech (Taiwan) JP001/Siroquine in glioblastoma: registry record stale since May 2021 (status UNKNOWN), no posted results, no paper, press item or licensee (HebaBiz) news found in English searches. Cannot tell whether the trial completed; nothing public located.

XZP-3621 (dirozalkib, trial later named DIAMOND-2): earliest source opened is Xuanzhu's draft HKEX listing document (date 17 Sep 2025 inferred from the HKEX file name) stating significant PFS benefit vs crizotinib; fuller data at AACR 2026 (HR 0.47, about 19 Apr 2026). True first disclosure is probably earlier: NDA accepted 2 May 2024, first listing application 25 Nov 2024, NMPA approval Aug 2025, none of which I could open with the result; registry record stale since 2022.

Gilead release of 30 May 2024 gave no numbers; HR first at ESMO Asia 2024 (LBA9, 7 Dec 2024 per ESMO listing; article opened is dated 19 Dec 2024). Registry PCD (Jul 2025) is over a year after the readout.

FS-1502 (IKS014/LCB14) vs T-DM1, Fosun: registry stale since Sep 2023 (status UNKNOWN, estimated PCD Jul 2025); English, Chinese and Korean (partner LigaChem) searches found only phase 1 data and "phase 3 ongoing" statements. No result located; a Chinese exchange notice could exist that I did not find.

J&J topline of 16 Oct 2025 (PFS met, OS also significant at first interim) gave no numbers; HR first at ASH 2025 LBA-6 with NEJM epub 9 Dec 2025. The ASH late-breaking abstract text may have been posted in late Nov 2025; not verified.
lidERA (acronym not in the registry acronym field): Roche release of 18 Nov 2025 said IDFS met at a pre-planned interim analysis, no numbers; HR first at SABCS on 10 Dec 2025.

VIALE-T terminated for "strategic considerations"; no AbbVie release, abstract or paper found. Registry results posted 4 Jun 2026 give a descriptive stratified HR only and state that hypothesis testing was not performed because the planned number of events was not reached.

Cogent PEAK topline press release of 10 Nov 2025 included median PFS and HR; I opened trade coverage of 11 Nov 2025 because the Cogent investor site blocked retrieval. Registry still lists the study as RECRUITING with eight "primary" outcomes, mostly PK.

which_endpoint: pCR (first of two primaries; EFS reported met later)
search_notes: KEYNOTE-522: Merck release of 29 Jul 2019 (opened via same-day trade coverage) said the pCR primary was met at interim analysis. pCR has no HR; the HR fields give the first public EFS HR (interim, not yet significant) from ESMO on 29 Sep 2019, and the registry PCD (Oct 2025) reflects final follow-up, hence a lag of about -6.2 years.

CSPC SKLB1028 (ruserontinib) ALIVE: registry stale since Nov 2021 (status UNKNOWN); English and Chinese searches and a drug news tracker show no interim CR/CRh or OS result, filing or termination notice. Nothing public located.

OBI Pharma (Taiwan) GLORIA: material-information announcement of 23 Apr 2025 said the DSMB recommended stopping after the second interim analysis (113 of 187 events) and the company ended the trial; no efficacy numbers given and the full text on the company site is password-protected, so "futility" rests on Taiwanese press wording. Registry still shows ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING.

EpicentRx (private) REPLATINUM, RRx-001/nibrozetone: registry last updated Oct 2024, estimated PCD 31 Dec 2025; no topline release, abstract or posted result found by acronym, drug names or NCT number.

CSPC DP303c vs trastuzumab+chemo: registry still NOT_YET_RECRUITING and unchanged since Jun 2023; the programme appears to have moved to a different phase 3 (vs T-DM1, NCT06313086). No result found; the trial may never have enrolled.

TiNivo-2 (acronym not in the registry field): AVEO release of 18 Jul 2024 gave no numbers; HR at ESMO 2024 with Lancet epub 13 Sep 2024. Registry lists PCD as 20 Jan 2026 (ACTUAL), 18 months after the readout.

Akeso AK104-306 (COMPASSION-22): Akeso's interim results announcement of 27 Aug 2026 lists the trial only as "enrolment completed March 2025"; no interim or final RFS result in English or Chinese searches. Registry still says RECRUITING.
Boston Scientific MANDARIN (TheraSphere vs cTACE, China, n=92): registry COMPLETED (PCD 13 Feb 2026) with no posted results; no release, abstract or paper found in English or Chinese searches.
Henlius ASTRIDE (US bridging trial vs atezolizumab): registry ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, estimated PCD Feb 2026; Henlius 2026 interim results release (21 Aug 2026) and searches show no OS readout.

which_endpoint: OS (overall population and PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN-altered; dual primary, both missed)
search_notes: AstraZeneca announcement of 18 Jun 2024 (RNS, furnished on Form 6-K) gave no numbers; HRs at ESMO 2024 LBA19 on 13 Sep 2024 (altered subgroup HR 1.05, 0.77-1.43). Registry PCD is still an ESTIMATED Mar 2026, 21 months after the readout.

ADC Therapeutics LOTIS-5 topline of 3 Jun 2026 (press release and slides furnished on Form 8-K) gave HR 0.73, two-sided p=0.008, median PFS 6.1 vs 4.7 months; no confidence interval in the sources opened.
Karyopharm topline release of 30 Jul 2026 (also filed on Form 8-K; opened via a news mirror) included median PFS, HR and one-sided p=0.0791.
Shanghai Pharma SPH4336 + letrozole (phase 2/3): registry RECRUITING, last updated Aug 2025, estimated PCD May 2026; English and Chinese searches found no ORR or PFS result or exchange notice.

which_endpoint: OS in PD-L1-high (durvalumab+chemo met; durvalumab+tremelimumab+chemo not met)
search_notes: NILE: no stand-alone press release found; the result first appears as a "new disclosure" in the pipeline table of AstraZeneca's H1/Q2 2026 results announcement of 27 Jul 2026 (later 6-K text says "July 2026"). No hazard ratio public yet.
CELESTIMO: Roche release of 17 Sep 2026 said PFS met at interim analysis, OS immature, no numbers; data to be shown at an upcoming meeting, so no hazard ratio is public yet.

Henlius serplulimab + chemoradiotherapy in limited-stage SCLC (HLX10-020-SCLC302): registry ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, estimated PCD Jun 2026; no PFS/OS result in English or Chinese searches or in the Henlius 2026 interim results release.

which_endpoint: PFS (interim analysis; SHR-A1811 with or without pertuzumab vs THP)
search_notes: Hengrui SHR-A1811-307 (trastuzumab rezetecan): Chinese business press of 2 Sep 2026 reports the company announced on 31 Aug 2026 that PFS was met at interim analysis; I could not open the original Hengrui notice, so the channel (press release vs exchange notice) is unconfirmed. Result found only in Chinese; no hazard ratio public.

Hansoh voluntary HKEX announcement of 28 Jul 2026: HS-20093 (risvutatug rezetecan; trial named ARTEMIS-011, not in registry) met the IRC-assessed PFS primary; no numbers, data promised for a congress. Disclosure came a month before the registry's estimated PCD.
Bio-Thera BAT1308 in cervical cancer: registry RECRUITING (last update Feb 2025, estimated PCD Sep 2026); no PFS/OS result in English or Chinese searches.

Chia Tai Tianqing TQB2450 (benmelstobart) + anlotinib after chemoradiotherapy in limited-stage SCLC: registry status UNKNOWN (last update Jul 2024, estimated PCD Sep 2026); searches return only the earlier phase 1b and readouts of other benmelstobart phase 3 trials in NSCLC, which are easy to confuse with this one.
Roche MO41552 (entrectinib vs crizotinib, ROS1 NSCLC): registry ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING with estimated PCD 30 Sep 2026; no Roche release, abstract or posted result found.
